name: 36695 · Mobile, AL
findings: ZIP 36695 (Mobile) has 134 nonprofit organizations. 44 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (26% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 36695 (Mobile) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 36695 (Mobile) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 75% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find groups to join now, including outside formal organizations?

observations.title: Housing organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 18 housing organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
